statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a ≤ b → b < 1 → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc a b, ExpandingCodes.SharpThreshold.TwoPointContraction p r
proof_route: An elementary polynomial strong-convexity proof replaces the calculus route. If |u|,|v|≤1, factor u⁴−v⁴−(4/3)v(u³−v³) as (u−v)²(u²+(2/3)uv+v²/3). Put Q=u²+uv+v². Then 0≤Q≤3, Q²≤3Q, and Q/6≤u²+(2/3)uv+v²/3, giving tangent gap≥(u³−v³)²/18. Signed cube roots convert this to a tangent bound for |x|^(4/3) on [-1,1], including crossing zero. Weighted tangent bounds at the mean give a Jensen gap≥p(1−p)(x−y)²/18. For 0≤B≤A and δ≤A, A^(3/2)−B^(3/2)≥√δ(A−B), proved by factoring square roots. Normalize arbitrary x,y by M=max(|x|,|y|). The normalized moment A is at least min(p,1−p), since one absolute value is one. Combining these facts proves the desired noise contraction whenever r²≤√δ/18. Set δ=min(a,1−b), r=√(√δ/18). Both are positive and r<1. Rescale by M²; handle M=0 separately.
components: cube_tangent_bound: explicit degree-six polynomial inequality on signed cube roots
exists_bounded_cube: bounded signed cube-root parametrization using real rpow
bounded_rpow_jensen: weighted quadratic Jensen gap on [-1,1]
rpow_three_halves and rpow_gap: monotone square-root conversion of Jensen gap
bounded_noise_contraction: variance identity plus the two gap bounds
failed_approaches: The earlier calculus/compactness route was not needed; no obstruction was found.
Initial nlinarith square-bound attempt omitted the product (1−|u|)(1+|u|)≥0; supplying that factor repairs it.
simp [neg_pow] recursed in the signed-root cases; polynomial ring normalization replaces it.
